description: Formation of a rear roof terrace at the second floor, accessed by replacing an existing rear window with a new door.
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of its location and detailed design, would result in an obtrusive and incongruous form of development that would fail to be subordinate to and in keeping with the host building,&nbsp; and would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage, conservation and growth) of The London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets)&nbsp;and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).

<p>The proposed roof terrace, because of its size and location, would result in a harmful impact on the privacy and amenities of the adjoining properties, specifically the neighbouring occupier at No. 89 Lower Clapton Road, by way of a loss of privacy and outlook, and the occupying residents at No.87 Lower Clapton&nbsp;Road by way of a loss of privacy. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).&nbsp;</p>
